summary: Tested Mail Pulse email validator (backend + frontend). Backend: 10/10 pytest passing — mixed categorization (deliverable/invalid_syntax/disposable/risky-role/no_mx), empty-list 4xx, blank-only 400, dedupe on/off, history list & detail, delete + invalid ids. Frontend: sample fill, validate flow with progress, metrics populate (12/8/4/67%), deliverable+invalid box counts and lists match, copy-to-clipboard verified for deliverable, CSV download triggered for both boxes (deliverable-emails.csv, invalid-emails.csv), history drawer opens, batch listed, click loads batch back into metrics. All data-testids present and working.

minor.issue: No max-size limit on emails list — potential DoS with very large payloads; also DNS lookups blocking event-loop thread pool if list is huge.
Hardcoded limit=100 with no pagination params (skip/limit).
Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer lifespan context.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility). Add SheetDescription or aria-describedby to SheetContent.

action_items: Optional: add SheetDescription/aria-describedby to HistoryPanel's SheetContent to remove Radix a11y warning.
Optional: add server-side max-length validation on emails list (e.g., <= 5000) and pagination to /api/history.
critical_code_review_comments: _mx_cache is an unbounded in-memory dict — over long uptime could grow; consider TTL or LRU.
_check_mx falls back to A-record and treats it as MX-active (has_mx=True); technically incorrect per RFC 5321 §5.1 (implicit MX only when no MX). This may mislabel domains without MX as deliverable.
DNS resolver timeout=4s x N threads with fixed 12 workers means a batch of 100 no-MX domains can block up to ~34s serially inside thread pool — acceptable but consider surfacing per-item timeouts.
server.py mixes routes/models/validation in one 293-line file — OK for MVP but should be split when it grows.
PyObjectId class defined but unused — dead code.
seed_data_creation: Test batches created with TEST_ prefix are auto-cleaned via pytest fixture. One UI batch 'TEST_UI_BATCH' left in DB from playwright run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green; pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_validator.py can be reused. Playwright flow covers sample → validate → copy/download → history load. Live DNS: gmail/microsoft/outlook/stripe/github resolve; nonexistentdomain-xyz-123.com correctly no_mx.
